note: Extracted from docs/DECISIONS.md §4.2. Languages are tiered, not cut: a tier-3 language gets guaranteed coverage even where fertility cannot be brought down.

tiers.note: Urdu included deliberately — see the vocabulary scope.

other.note: Measured the other way round: more characters per token is better.
Digits atomic; frequent LaTeX commands single-token.
100 turns x 30 wasted structural tokens is 3,000 tokens burned on punctuation.

headline.name: parity ratio
headline.definition: max(fertility over tier A) divided by fertility(English)
headline.why: One number that states the India-first claim quantitatively.
headline.blocked_by: Defined against our own candidate tokenizer, which has never been trained.
